# keeper-security

> Safe AI agent access to Keeper Security: a Claude Code and Cursor plugin marketplace (keeper-admin, keeper-msp, keeper-secrets, keeper-setup) and keeper-mcp, a local stdio MCP server with 26 tools that wraps the Keeper Commander CLI, redacts secret fields by default, and gates irreversible actions behind explicit confirmation.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/patrickking67/keeper-security/blob/main/README.md): what the repo contains and how to install the marketplace, skills and MCP server
- [MCP server guide](https://github.com/patrickking67/keeper-security/blob/main/docs/mcp-server.md): authentication bootstrap, environment variables, client registration, tool list, security notes
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/patrickking67/keeper-security/blob/main/AGENTS.md): layout, commands, safety rules and conventions for contributors and coding agents

## Plugins

- [keeper-admin](https://github.com/patrickking67/keeper-security/tree/main/plugins/keeper-admin): vault records, enterprise admin, PAM sessions, rotation, compliance reports with Commander
- [keeper-msp](https://github.com/patrickking67/keeper-security/tree/main/plugins/keeper-msp): managed companies, licenses, MSP billing, switch-to-mc
- [keeper-secrets](https://github.com/patrickking67/keeper-security/tree/main/plugins/keeper-secrets): Keeper Secrets Manager CLI, ksm exec, Keeper notation
- [keeper-setup](https://github.com/patrickking67/keeper-security/tree/main/plugins/keeper-setup): installing the CLIs and first-time profile setup
- [Claude Code marketplace manifest](https://github.com/patrickking67/keeper-security/blob/main/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json)

## Project

- [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/patrickking67/keeper-security/blob/main/SECURITY.md): private vulnerability reporting and scope
